answer_1.quote: We introduce a novel task named, OpenCQA in which the system takes a chart and a question as input and is expected to produce a descriptive answer as output
answer_1.outputs: descriptive answers to open-ended questions about charts

answer_2.quote: We utilized six measures for automatic evaluation. BLEU measures n-gram overlaps between the model generated text and the reference... ROUGE... CIDEr... BLEURT... Content Selection or CS score... and BERTScore

answer_4.quote: To further assess the quality of the answers generated by the models, we performed a human study on 150 randomly sampled charts from our OpenCQA dataset with three internal annotators who are native speakers of English
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assessed each answer based on three criteria adapted from prior work and a new recall-oriented criteria called Content Coverage, using a 5-point Likert scale
